To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
data clouds can help users to navigate and summarize the search results of keyword searches on structured data.
data clouds are effective for summarizing the results of keyword queries over structured data and that data clouds are an effective tool for helping users to refine their queries.

1) keyword searches over structured databases are more effective than keyword searches over unstructured data; 2) keyword searches can be coupled with data clouds to help users navigate structured databases; 3) our system CourseCloud is more effective than typical search interfaces for a course database.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing techniques to summarize the results returned by keyword searches over structured databases.
the design, development and evaluation of a novel interface to a structured database.
the design and implementation of a new search and browse paradigm that can summarize and guide users to the relevant information in a database.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we present a novel and effective approach to summarizing keyword search over structured data, using tag clouds, which can be applied to a wide range of applications.
the proposed approach is a good one for summarizing the results of keyword search over structured databases.
we propose a novel way to summarize and navigate over structured data and that we present a system that implements this approach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an approach that combines the flexibility of keyword search with the navigation capabilities of tag cloud for structured data.
data clouds can help users access structured databases in a more efficient and intuitive manner.
we have developed a system that allows users to browse and search a database using a unified interface.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed data clouds can be a useful interface to databases for both novice and expert users, especially when the database contains large amounts of data.
the proposed data clouds are a powerful tool that can be applied to many other structured databases.
data clouds are a promising approach to help users access structured databases through keyword searches.
